records.claim: Two studies reported that preterm delivery (birth before week 37) and lower birth weight (less than 6lbs) were more common in pregnant women treated with calcium channel blockers such as nifedipine. The authors of the studies suggest the cause of these complications is likely due to the illnesses being treated rather than the medications.
records.source_section: Does taking nifedipine in pregnancy increase the chance of other pregnancy-related problems?
